name: Person actions of another site are refused every time
title: SC-12-10-10 Person actions of another site are refused every time
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a manager of another site
When that manager reads, edits, opens a login for and merges a card of this site, twice each
Then every request is refused and the card, its login status and its history are unchanged
